entries.text: Dana from Finance just forwarded a suspicious email to our security inbox. Read the newest report in the Phishing reports folder, then have our Launchpad triage agent investigate it in Splunk.
I'll start by reading the phishing report from Outlook, then run the Splunk Launchpad triage agent on it. First I'm loading the Outlook tools and the splunkctl skill.
Listing mail folders next so I can open Phishing reports and pull Dana’s newest message.

Reported by Dana Lee (`dana.lee@acme-corp.example`).
Original sender: Northwind Billing `<ap-notices@northwind-billing.example>`.
Subject: Invoice INV-88213 overdue – action required. Link: `https://northwind-billing.example/portal/inv/88213`.

Starting PhishingTriageAgent in Splunk on that sender and link.

entries.command: splunkctl search 'index=demo_soc sourcetype=email:gateway sender_domain="northwind-billing.example" action=delivered | stats values(recipient) AS r | eval r=mvjoin(r, ",")' --max-time 120 -o json

entries.text: The search found 14 mailboxes, which matches the triage count. Next I'm running the containment command without `--yes`, so it should stop and ask for approval.

entries.result: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: n8n-contain needs approval; rerun with --yes

```bash
n8n-contain --case PH-1042 --message-id '<88213.ap-notices@northwind-billing.example>' --domain northwind-billing.example --recipients aisha.khan@acme-corp.example,ben.carter@acme-corp.example,dana.lee@acme-corp.example,ethan.wu@acme-corp.example,grace.kim@acme-corp.example,jack.ross@acme-corp.example,luis.romero@acme-corp.example,maria.garcia@acme-corp.example,mark.chen@acme-corp.example,nina.patel@acme-corp.example,olivia.brooks@acme-corp.example,priya.shah@acme-corp.example,sam.okafor@acme-corp.example,tom.alvarez@acme-corp.example --yes
```

n8n will then purge the email from all 14 mailboxes the gateway delivered it to, block `northwind-billing.example`, and post the result to Slack. Do you approve?
